messages.content: Gretchen has some coins. There are 30 more gold coins than silver coins. Each gold coin is worth $10. If she had 70 gold coins, how many coins did Gretchen have in total?

content.text:
Gretchen has 70 gold coins. Since each gold coin is worth $10, the total value of her gold coins is:
70 × $10 = $700

But the question asks how many coins she has in total. She has 70 gold coins and 30 more gold coins than silver coins, so she has:
70 - 30 = 40 silver coins

Total coins: 70 + 40 = **110 coins**
